name: Marks
source:
...Well, I guess there's no need for me to reintroduce myself, since I'm your gun, Master.
From now on, I'll be by your side as a gun knight.
I swear I'll shoot through all of your enemies, every single one of them.
Ah, and also... it doesn't have to be often, but I'd be happy if you'd still use me as a gun with your own hands every now and then, like you used to.
translation:
...Well, I guess there's no need for me to reintroduce myself, since I'm your gun, Master.
From now on, I'll be by your side as a gun knight.
I swear I'll shoot through all of your enemies, every single one of them.
Ah, and also... it doesn't have to be often, but I'd be happy if you'd still use me as a gun with your own hands every now and then, like you used to.
